title: flexion
body:
this morning i ate yogurt with the handle,
because the spoon part felt nice in the pad
of my thumb.
floated beside my bike; a remora on a cable
car charging out of the sea like a fleeting
ponyo memory.
i fell off. headphones, an anchor chain to my
handlebar dragging my eustachians down
like whale fall. bound. can't equalize. when
did i get this colossal and this clumsy?

am i retreating or succumbing to the
colorless silt? now
i'm watching books and reading movies in
the caps of passing jellies.

i mustve gotten out of the left side of my
bed today.
but isn't that side up against the wall?
